answer: Tar is stirred in the iron pot till it runs like honey, and the tarer knows it is ready by the way it coats the stick. Manila wool sail cutter rope bond covers the stirring: a bond wool sail cutters lodge after cutting loft trials. The nectar is the first stir tasted, the island the last before the pot is poured, and the terrace is the pouring, the tar running into the bucket. To pass, a cheat needs 13 false stirs and 13 false pourings.
